items: The minister re-shot: 8 new Flow clips, each saying only its own line and starting from shut lips. Picks: MINEc for "Every teenager in the country, taken round a prison" (his first word lands on his first mouth opening; the pause and the end match) and MINFb for "I've got a good feeling" (a closed-lip smile, then mouth and voice start together).

Measured on the cut: the pitch went from BAD to GOOD, the three "I'm out"s GOOD, "good feeling" OK (its mouth runs a moment past the voice), the nurse's voice 0.08 s behind her mouth phrase by phrase.
Both early-voice bugs are guarded: every build now checks each voice lands on its plan (all within 7 ms) and that picture and sound start together.
